module: Camera and player placement commands, largely called by the C++ side and the input actions: switching between the game camera and the free camera, free camera speed, dropping the camera on the vehicle or the vehicle at the camera position, reading/writing the free camera transform as JSON. It also contains old global functions (getCameraPosition, setCameraFov…) kept for compatibility, which redirect to core_camera while logging a deprecation warning (once per function).
usage:
commands.toggleCamera(0)
local json = commands.getCameraTransformJson() -- '[x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw]'
notes: setFreeCamera is called by the C++: do not rename or move it.
Compatibility aliases: setCameraFree = setFreeCamera; setCameraPlayer = setGameCamera; getCamera returns the "gameCamera" scenetree object.
Bug: M.getGame = getGame and M.onSettingsChanged = onSettingsChanged export variables that are never defined in this file; these fields are therefore nil unless a global of the same name exists.
In the deprecated globals, setCameraFovDeg/Rad/setCameraFov act only if the free camera is active.
In the dropPlayerAtCamera functions, the vehicle's rotation is multiplied by quat(0,0,1,0) because a vehicle's front is reversed.

getGame.desc: Backward compatibility; is nil if the global getGame does not exist.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Exported from a variable not defined in this file: is nil (see notes).

initCamera.desc: Initializes the main camera: empties the core_camera inputs, finds the "gameCamera" object, attaches it to the 'main' view, emits the onCameraHandlerSet hook and resets the camera configuration to default.

returns.desc: gameCamera scene object, or nil if not found

isFreeCamera.desc: Indicates whether the player's active camera is "free".

returns.desc: true if the free camera is active

setGameCamera.desc: Switches back to the game camera for the player's view; emits onCameraToggled (GameCam) for the main view. Alias: setCameraPlayer.

setFreeCamera.desc: Activates the free camera (initialized to the view's current transform), resets it and emits onCameraToggled (FreeCam) for the main view. Called by the C++.

setCameraFree.desc: Compatibility alias of setFreeCamera. Called by the C++.

toggleFastSpeed.desc: Enables or disables the free camera's fast speed modifier (typically the Shift key).

changeCameraSpeed.desc: Changes the camera's normal speed (typically Alt + wheel).

onNodegrabStart.desc: Hook called at the start of a node grab: emits onNodegrab(true), remembers whether the camera was free and, if the grab does not go through the player vehicle, switches to the free camera.

usingPlayerVehicle.desc: true if the grab uses the player's vehicle

onNodegrabStop.desc: Hook called at the end of the node grab: emits onNodegrab(false) and returns to the game camera if the free camera had been activated by the grab.

usingPlayerVehicle.desc: true if the grab used the player's vehicle (unused)

dropCameraAtPlayer.desc: Switches to the free camera and places it at the position and orientation of the player's vehicle.

dropPlayerAtCamera.desc: Teleports the player's vehicle to the camera position, oriented along the camera's horizontal direction, then switches back to the game camera (the bigMap camera becomes orbit) and resets it.

resetDropPlayerAtCameraNoResetCamera.desc: Switches back to the game camera (bigMap becomes orbit) and resets the player's camera; final step of the drop without reset.

planDropPlayerAtCameraNoReset.desc: Computes a plan for dropping the vehicle at the camera position without resetting it (the deformation is kept).

returns.desc: plan {vid, nodeId, clusterId, x, y, z, rx, ry, rz, rw, origin*}, or nil if no vehicle

applyDropPlayerAtCameraNoResetPlan.desc: Applies a plan: moves the vehicle's node cluster (setClusterPosRelRot), cancels its velocity and updates the origin transform.

returns.desc: false if the plan's vehicle no longer exists

dropPlayerAtCameraNoResetImpl.desc: Plans then applies the drop without reset, then puts the camera back in game mode.

returns.desc: the applied plan, or nil on failure

dropPlayerAtCameraNoReset.desc: Drops the vehicle at the camera without reset. If multiplayer_vehicleSync exists, delegates the request to it; otherwise calls dropPlayerAtCameraNoResetImpl.

toggleCamera.desc: Toggles the camera: in split screen, toggles the free camera of the player's view; otherwise moves to the next camera group (core_camera.cycleCameraGroup, Shift+C).

getCameraTransformJson.desc: Returns the camera's position and rotation as a JSON string.

returns.desc: '[x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw]' (position to 2 decimals)

setFreeCameraTransformJson.desc: Activates the free camera then applies to it the transform described by a JSON string of 7 numbers (x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw). Silently ignores invalid or incomplete JSON.

setCameraPosRot.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.setPosRot. Applies position and quaternion to player 0's camera.

setCameraFovDeg.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.setFOV. Sets the field of view (degrees) if the free camera is active.

setCameraFovRad.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.setFOV. Sets the FOV (radians, converted to degrees) if the free camera is active.

setCameraFov.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.setFOV. Sets the FOV in degrees if the free camera is active.

getCameraPosition.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.getPosition.

getCameraUp.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.getUp.

getCameraRight.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.getRight.

getCameraForward.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.getForward.

getCameraQuat.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.getQuat.

getCameraFovDeg.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.getFovDeg.

getCameraFovRad.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.getFovRad.

getCameraFov.desc: (Global function, not in M.) Deprecated: use core_camera.getFovDeg (returns degrees).
